This article briefly describes the fractional order PID controller, and through Oustaloup number of filtering methods to achieve a fractional order PID controller, then tuning various parameters of the controller by the genetic algorithm, at last used it in the process of the regulator SVC voltage. The results of Simulation show that:in the application of SVC, fractional order PID control can significantly speed up the speed of the voltage regulator, and accelerate the process of system voltage stability.

articleTitle: Research on Chaotic Threshold Criterion Based on the Difference of Solution
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In the processing of weak signal detection using chaotic oscillator, chaotic threshold criterion is always attention of experts at home and abroad. In this paper, according to Duffing equation's almost periodicity, a new threshold criterion method based on difference of chaotic system solution is proposed. For comparison between the method and phase plane method, these methods all can realize chaotic threshold criterion under the same conditions. Simulation results are presented to validate the proposed threshold criterion method. Furthermore, from the simulation results, it can be seen that the proposed method is simple algorithm, high accuracy, unaffected by human and outperforms the other methods.

articleTitle: A Model for Simulation on Grounding Resistance of Shore Power
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: According to the commonly used foundation building grounding way to reduce grounding resistance of experience, the paper put forward to shore power grounding device grounding electrode can adopt Foundation Grounding mode. On the basis of the grounding resistance of the ANSYS simulation, with the vertical grounding electrode resistance calculation results compared to determine the basis of grounding, availability, and the terminal grounding device and hull need not connecting the conductors to the conclusion. The study on terminal grounding device grounding electrode to provide a theoretical basis for design, for shore power system operation security guarantees.

articleTitle: A Detection Framework for Ship in Sea-Sky Background Based on Constrained Feature Points
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: An automated scheme for sea-sky background ship segmentation is proposed. Feature points based on Harris operator are first calculated to extract the important information of the image, and then a constrained feature points methodology based on fractal theory is utilized in order to get the precise location of the ship. Finally region growing algorithm is used in the vicinity of the reserved feature points to segment the ship target from the sea-sky background. The proposed scheme is validated on a large number of sea-sky background images. It is shown to perform well to get the outline of the ship with little time.

articleTitle: A Novel and Flexible RSA Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Large number computation is acknowledged as the bottleneck of the RSA algorithm. We present an adjustable Montgomery modular multiplication architecture with a new CSA tree. Then we implemented RSA cryptosystems on FPGA, evaluated its throughput and area. The different optimized combinations were found for frequency and circuit cost. Comparing with other studies, it shows that the proposed RSA system achieved a better performance-cost and the design can be adjusted to satisfy verity performance and cost requirements.

articleTitle: 100-km Long-Reach WDM-PON Using High Power Efficient On-Off Keying Codes in Downstream
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: A scheme of long-reach RSOA based WDM-PON is proposed and simulated. By using 10Gbit/s high power efficient coded downstream signals such as RZ, IRZ and PPM, the coverage of WDM-PON is extended to 100km.

articleTitle: The Marine Environment Monitoring Sensor Network Research Based on the Coupling Communication Chain
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In order to realize the real-time and reliable monitoring of the marine environment, a marine environment monitoring sensor network system was designed, which based on coupling communication chain. The system is mainly consisting of many underwater sensor data acquisition nodes, these nodes based on STM32F107VCT6. The system use double CAN bus as the communication channel to connect each sensor data acquisition node and establish a reliable sensor network, the data buoy will collect data from every node and send to the shore-based data center through the satellite, and then the host computer software will give a real-time display.

articleTitle: Communication Synchronization in Wireless Optical Link
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: An FPGA based transceiving synchronization method is demonstrated for Free Space Optical (FSO) communication system, which is discussed separately as the transmitting protocol and the receiving protocol. During the discussion of these two parts, the co-operation of them is also discussed. The transmitting protocol interfaces the outer input data with a parallel port, buffers the input data, encodes the input data stream, serializes the parallel data and outputs the serialized data. It also has an output management unit to manage the activity of each part of the transmitting protocol. The receiving protocol filters and synchronizes the input serial data stream, parallels the serial data stream, decodes the input data, checks received error, handles transmission exception and interfaces the outer receiver with a parallel port. The entire transceiving protocol could be programmed into a single FPGA chip to improve system integrity and reduce the system cost. The presented protocol could be taken as "protocol transparent" for outer interfaces, meaning that when interfacing the presented system to an outer system, users don't have to consider what protocol the outer system transceiving data stream is under, for example, the TCP/IP protocol or anything else, in the case that its I/O interface is a parallel port. Simulation and final experiment prove that the protocol presented is a working solution at a certain bit rate scale.

articleTitle: Study on Control Strategy and Simulation for Parallel Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: To make the engine worked in high efficient areas, and the value of State of Charge (SOC) of battery maintained in reasonable working range, the logic threshold control strategy for parallel hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) based on the control of the engine operating points and the optimization working interval of the battery is proposed, the working modes of hybrid electric vehicle are discussed, and the demand torque in each working mode is analyzed. The Matlab/Cruise co-simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can make the engine worked mostly in high efficient areas which achieve the high energy conversion efficiency of system, the SOC value maintained in the reasonable interval, and can realize the reasonable torque distribution between the engine and motor.

articleTitle: Application of WLAN Technology in the Intelligent Substation Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Consulting the promulgation of the IEC61850 standard communication system, it explores the application of WLAN technology in the intelligent substation network, from the technical requirements, 802.11 protocols, implementation steps, combination mode etc. By the calculation of the 1588 check-times message, it expounds application content of the wireless network technology, based on the current intelligent substation hot technology. With the development of research, wireless network technology used in electric power system of communication system is an important supplementary means. It will provide important technical support for construction of smart grid, and even cloud technology.

articleTitle: New Device Design and Performance Test on Gas Generator in Automobile Airbag
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: An new test device to test gas generator performance in automobile airbag is built. It is made up of inflator jar, sliding track, lifting device and data acquisition system. This system can produce an analog signal which is similar to the impact signal of automobile crash. For get suitable data of acceleration and the duration of impact, lots of experiments have been done. When lifting height of inflator jar is 280mm, acceleration peak value is from 80.5g to 90.2g and dash duration is from 6ms to 8ms. They can meet require to detonate gas generator. There were five groups gas generators from SHANXI Jinheng auto-parts Co., LTD was tested and changing track of pressure and acceleration can be known clearly. Then forty-four gas generators contrast test were done separately in China and in USA. Test results from our designed device were very similar to USA device. It was confirmed that the device designed to test gas generator performance by ourselves was successful.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling of Computer-Supported Collaborative Learning System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The use of computer and internet technologies in the education domain has been characterized by the need of providing flexible systems that are adaptable to particular learning situations. In this context, Software Engineering (SE) has emerged as a software development paradigm suitable for obtaining reusable, flexible, and customizable distributed applications, which would provide great benefits to the e-Learning platform. Nevertheless, this SE-education relationship has not coped with the collaborative aspects and the pedagogic theories underlying the social constructivism that constitutes the basis for collaborative learning. This article describes the process undertaken by the authors when applying SE principles to the development of Computer-Supported Collaborative Learning (CSCL). It also demonstrated a collection of design patterns for developing highly reusable learning objects(LOs).

articleTitle: Research on XML Digital Signature Application in the Log Protection of Typesetting on Web
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the implementation and validation of XML digital signature, the syntax specification of XML digital signature and XML technology application in the structure modeling of the log of typesetting on Web. In the .NET Framework, XML digital signature and validation are achieved by C# programming language. And XML digital signature is put into use for protecting the log of typesetting on web, so the security, integrity and non-repudiation of the log of typesetting on web are realized.

articleTitle: Research of Embedded Linux SD Card Device Driver Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The secure digital (SD) card is a new generation memory device based on semiconductor flash memory. SDIO is one of the most important interface techniques of embedded system. Therefore, the paper analyzes the working principle of SD card and Linux MMC/SD/SDIO system structure. Finally, the SD card driver has been transplanted to a hardware platform based on AT91SAM9261 as the CPU.

articleTitle: Research of FTP Search Engine Indexing Technology Based on Kademlia Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: By Kademlia algorithm of the P2P network analysis and discussion, In this paper, it mainly puts forward an indexing algorithm which integrates the resource location information and combines with the structure characteristics of the distribution resources of FTP site and its file name features in a peer-to-peer network environment. Theoretical analysis and simulation result show that improved algorithm can accelerate resource locating speed and improve retrieval accuracy of distributed FTP search engine.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Network Coding Optimization Based on NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Network coding could effectively improve transmission performance of multicast network, but encoding of node brings the additional calculation cost of node. In order to overcome the overhead brought by network coding, a network coding optimization model under the framework of algebraic network coding is designed in this paper, and the joint optimization for both the link cost and coding cost of network coding are carried out based on this model. In addition, the paper proposes MOONC (Multi-Objective Optimization Problem of Network Coding) based on improved NSGA-II algorithm. Adopting non-dominated sorting mechanism, virtual fitness and elitist strategy, this algorithm could not only improve algorithm efficiency and convergence speed, but also guarantee the population diversity. The simulation for typical network topology shows that this algorithm is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Study on the Wind and Solar Hybrid Control System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In the Twelfth Five-Year Plan, a comprehensive layout has been made for the new energy industry as the representative of nuclear energy, wind, solar and so on in the future. The comprehensive utilization of renewable energy for sustainable development of social economy and environmental protection is very important. As two widely used renewable resource, solar and wind energy can complement each other in terms of resources and technical applications. This article introduces the design of hardware structure, working principle and design method of software of the wind and solar hybrid control system which based on PIC18F4520 microcontroller. It realizes the intelligence of management and control to Wind and Solar Hybrid system. The System is reliable, low cost, easy to implement, easy to maintain and upgrade.

articleTitle: A Model for Structural Vulnerability Analysis of Shipboard Power System Based on Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: A structural vulnerability analysis method of shipboard power system based on complex network is proposed in this paper. In this paper, the shipboard power system is modeled as a complex network, and topological characteristics of shipboard power grid are analyzed. Two structural vulnerability criterions, which are electric betweeness of node and cabin respectively, are defined to evaluate the importance of network elements and element groups in a cabin, and analysis structural vulnerability. The results of attack tests on a typical shipboard power system show that the structural vulnerability of shipboard power system has close relationship with topological structure and the cabin betweenness can effectively identify the structural vulnerability of shipboard power system.

articleTitle: Processing of Wellbore Anti-collision Signal Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The vibration caused by an approaching drill bit can be monitored from the existing well casing and used to pre-alarm the well bore collision of the offshore cluster well. For analyzing the non-stationary drill bit vibration signal under complicated drilling environment, use of conventional discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) has been known to be less efficient. To extract useful information contained in the bit signal, a new extraction method based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) is presented. In the signal processing, EMD is used to decompose the original drill bit vibration signal into the intrinsic mode functions (IMFs). By analyzing kurtosis and energy spectrum of the IMFs, the first five IMFs are found that contain the characteristic of the drill bit, and the specific frequency band of the bit vibration is determined after power spectrum analyzing. When the drill bit is approaching to the adjacent well, the reconstruction bit signal after band-pass filter changes significantly and agrees well with the on-site situation.

articleTitle: Design of Storage Testing and Measuring System Based on MSP430F133
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: A kind of design for storage testing system based on MSP430F133 is represented, on this basis", "the software and hardware design of this system is introduced and discussed in detail. In a word", "it meets the requirement of low power consumption and long time to complete the storage and testing tasks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of AGC Testing Diagnostic Analytic System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Automatic Generation Control (AGC) testing diagnostic analytic system of power grid is used for AGC test between grid dispatching center and the power generator set. It is also for collecting, processing, analyzing and evaluating the generator set's testing data. Eventually a set of assessment results can be achieved. This system is mainly used for testing, diagnosing and evaluating the functions of the power station's generator set, Distributed Control System (DCS) control system and remote control system (RTU). This system can not only support the message diagnosis of IEC60870-5-101, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3.0 and so on, but also be used for collecting and displaying the main parameters such as main steam pressure, temperature, etc. It also appraises the performance index of testing data of generator set.

articleTitle: Solution of Massive Data Update Performance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Nowadays, massive data continues to produce, which increases the scale of the database tables, a lot of performance problems come with the procedure of updating massive data tables. In this paper, to solve these problems, we propose new solutions based on Oracle RowID. In this way, we can update tables quickly. On the basis of studying the structure of Oracle data block and the RowID, we choose a flow dataset to test our solutions. The test results show that the new solutions can significantly shorten the execution time, and reduce the occupation of system resources.

articleTitle: Effect of Dielectric Substrate on Pole Characteristic of Chipless Tag
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Chipless RFID tag, whose specific conductor structure has unique scattering property to an incident electromagnetic wave, is a new kind of electronic card with no any integrated chips internally. Thus, poles of the chipless tag that used for tag recognition can be available through the scattering property by matrix pencil method. However, the accuracy of pole extraction, in general, is affected by many factors. The effect of lossless dielectric substrate, characterized by relative permittivity and thickness, on pole characteristic of folded dipole array chipless tag is mainly researched in the paper. Simulation result show that with the relative permittivity and thickness increase, frequency and damping factor of nature resonant pole decrease, leading the pole's distribution close to axis origin in the way of S shape-like curve gradually.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis of Signal and Noise Bandwidths for Microbolometric Focal Plane Array
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the signal and noise bandwidth expressions for microbolometric focal plane array are theoretically given out. By reviewing the basic working principle of micro bolometer, we have obtained the theoretical signal and noise bandwidth expressions for different links in a universal infrared responding signal process channel. Based on the analysis of infrared responding signal and different noise sources frequency characteristics, the final signal and different noise sources bandwidths are pointed out. The final signal and noise bandwidth expressions can be utilized to guide the performance improvement of microbolometric focal plane array.

articleTitle: Recognizing the Digital Code of Scanned Express Form Images through Template Matching
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology

articleTitle: Implementation of Multi-core Parallel Computation for Solving Large Dense Linear Equations Based on TBB
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Multi-threaded programming is the main means to make multi-core computer fully play to its potentials. This paper presents a complete solution of solving large dense linear equations with multi-core parallel computation based on Intel® Threading Building Blocks(TBB). The performance of our scheme is discussed in comparison with that of the sequential program running on the same computer. Numerical experimental results clearly show that it generally has a bit additional overhead, acceleration by parallel computing is significant to save the total execution time. It can achieve the speedup of 3.07 on a quad-core computer.

articleTitle: Structural Damping System Controlled by the Volterra Inverse and a Modal Transformation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This article presents a predistortion open loop control through a modified preinverse Volterra system for a structural system with hysteretic damping. An auxiliary signal is constructed to deal with the complex part of the complex rigidity. As the structural system is linear in frequency, only a first order Volterra inverse operator is needed. After applying the open loop control, the mean square error between the input signal (desired displacement) and the output signal (real displacement) results to be very small.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Webquest Publishing System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The Project-based learning of Web Quest could improve the students' research positivity and also the abilities of getting all kinds of resources online. And the important way for them is to quest information independently on the internet via the induction of their teachers. But it is a big problem all the time for the teaching-stuffs that how to get and share the educational resources in the best way. So we use net technology to develop the Web Quest distribution system. The system is developed because of the educational requirements of primary and secondary schools. And its resources framework is a definite topic, it is a program of convenience, function, joint development by teachers and students. The system is significant to improve and promote the reform of teaching.

articleTitle: The Contour Drawing Automatically Based on PDA Environment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This paper is focused on contour drawing based on PDAs automatically. We use the advantages of various techniques to improve the contour drawing and analysis of the accuracy and efficiency, thus becomes the pursuit of the goal of researchers. The advantage of this article is to integrate of these technologies and algorithms, which is based on the PDA environment and MapX Mobile component technology to complete the automatic drawing of the contour, and something useful is obtained.

articleTitle: Magnitude-Phase Controller (MPHC)
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology

articleTitle: Multi-beam Joint Detection Combination for TD-SCDMA Compatible Mobile Satellite Communication System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Based on the characteristic that received signals of different beam cells are sent to the same gateway station in the multi-beam satellite system, this paper introduces a technique of multi-beam joint detection combination for TD-SCDMA compatible mobile satellite communication system. The proposed technique adopts Adjacent Beam Assisted Single-beam Joint Detection (ABA-SB-JD) technique to get the detection signals of users in each target-beam cell and adjacent beam cells from the interference signals of users in adjacent beam cells, and detects the signal of the same user in each beam cell according to the maximal ratio combining principle. The simulation results show that this technique gets a good system bit-error rate performance, significantly reduces the SNR threshold of the system, and greatly improves multi-user detection performance of the multi-beam satellite communication system.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access
Author Keywords: Adjacent Beam Assisted Single-beam Joint Detection (ABA-SB-JD)

articleTitle: The Measurement of Strain Based on Finite Element Theory and Image Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: A large strain measurement program has been developed in Labview, which is based on digital image and finite element theory. It is a new method for strain measurement. This new method includes several steps: marking some circles on surface of the specimen, taking some pictures of the specimen before and after deformation, calculating the exact position of the mark center by the program, comparing the center position, and getting the strain according to the finite element theory. Finally, this paper gives experimental results, which proves the correctness of this method.

articleTitle: Design of On-Line Detected Multi-channel Video Signal Processing System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In order to achieve high real-time in online detection processing, a multi-channel video signal processing system consist of FPGA and DSP is proposed in this paper. In the system, FPGA as the main controller completes all control functions, DSP as the co-processor, focuses on the algorithm of a large number of data. The paper mainly analyzes the principle of the system, studies its hardware structure, describes the function of each part how to realize in detail, and completes hardware emulation via constructing System on Programmable Chip (SOPC) in FPGA. Meanwhile, the paper introduces the software flow path, and completes the acquisition, processing, transmission and display of the parallel real-time video signals. Experimental results reveal that the system has a great real-time.

articleTitle: A Joint Rapid Parameter Estimate Method of Frequency-Hopping Signals
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper, a new joint rapid method is presented, based on fast Fourier transformation (FFT) and multi-windows iterative smoothed pseudo Wigner-Ville distribution (SPWVD) to estimate parameters of frequency-hopping (FH) signals. Firstly, the approximate range including hop timing is searched by segmented FFT, then the both ends of the data segments by multi-windows iterative SPWVD, combining with statistics about the ends to obtain more accurate estimation of the parameters. This method can be easily implemented with lower computation complexity, and making real-time estimation possible. Simulation results show that the method can more rapidly and accurately estimate parameters of FH signals in the low SNR.

articleTitle: AGC Algorithm for IEEE 802.11a Based on Correlator and Threshold Detector
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Analog to digital converters (ADC) are utilized broadly in signal processing systems for converting analog signals into digital signals. However, in the progress of ADC, if the received signal power exceeds the operation range of receiver, the system performance is degraded drastically. In this paper, we propose an Automatic Gain Control (AGC) design scheme for IEEE 802.11a based on the correlator and threshold detector. The proposed scheme estimates the received signal power using the correlation value with the Short Training Sequence (STS) of preamble and transmits these parameters to the AGC for gain control of receiver. In addition, if the high power received signal that exceeds the operating range of ADC is received, proposed scheme can control the correlation output using the threshold detector and feedback loop. The proposed scheme has the large operating range more than 60 dB and can be performed by two short training sequences.

articleTitle: QoS Scheme of Satellite Access Networks for IMS-Based Core Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) is the core architecture for controlling the session in Next Generation Network (NGN), and satellite communication system has its superiority in geography and bandwidth, so it is necessary to converge satellite in IMS. In this paper, we briefly introduced an architecture of satellite access network and the satellite access gateway, framework of QoS is designed for satellite accessing to IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) core networks, and an enhanced QoS controller is proposed to ensure the QoS.

articleTitle: A Research for Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In recent years, there is an incredible growth of network methods to explore functionality of genes from the system level. However, most researchers are focused on the unweighted networks. In this paper, a new weighted networks method is established. To evaluate the efficiency of the method, application of the method to screen diabetic candidate pathogenic gene and module recognition are also given.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of a Warm Standby Repairable Human and Machine System with Two Same Components
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The reliability analysis of a warm standby repairable human & machine system with two same components is studied in the paper. By the reliability theory, the dynamic solution of the system is exponential stability and tends to the steady solution of the system. Last, the reliability of the system will be analyzed.

articleTitle: The Risk Management Research of Virtual Enterprise Based on Auction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: We research on the risk allocation problem of virtual enterprise, and put forward a method to solve the risk management problem of virtual enterprise based on auction. Firstly, the leader requires the members to use bidding mechanism to offer the risk control level and the corresponding risk control cost. Then the leader uses the risk decision model to maximize the risk control revenue with the bidding information offered by the members. Finally, the leader decides who undertakes the risk control task according to the decision result. The method can help the leader to effectively assign the risk control task among the virtual enterprise. We provide a new way to manage the risk of virtual enterprise.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification in Microbial Continuous Fermentation with Intracellular Substrate and Products
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper, a dynamic system is improved to describe microbial continuous fermentation. Taking the average relative error as the objective function, a parameter identification model is built, the existence of optimal parameters is proved, and the Improved Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is used for solving the optimal parameters. The numerical results show that, the average relative error is cut down by 4.136%~9.248%, and the dynamic system can describe microbial continuous fermentation better.

articleTitle: A Segmentation Algorithm for Touching Character Based on the Invariant Moments and Profile Feature
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Automatic Detection of Banners in Surveillance Videos
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper we mainly focus on the effects of two different algorithms for automatic detection of banners in practical use. These two algorithms are scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT) and Hough transform-based contour feature extraction method, respectively. A new algorithm based on color threshold and corner detector is described. This algorithm can capture color features and corner of images effectively, especially for objects with certain color such as bright red banners. The experimental results indicate that we can obtain the most stable and effective structure element characteristic in images when applying the algorithm based on color threshold and corner detector.

articleTitle: Adaptive Simulator of Power Amplifier Nonlinearity Based on Piecewise Polynomial
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In the wireless communication system, power amplifier nonlinearity has bad effects on transmitting signals and changes channel characteristics. In order to exactly estimate communication system performance, a channel simulator needs to simulate power amplifier nonlinearity. This paper proposes a novel adaptive simulator based on piecewise polynomial. Learning from the digital predistortion technique of power amplifier, the proposed method uses adaptive study structure. It adds a nonlinear preprocessing module before the radio power amplifier of channel simulator, and uses adaptive algorithm to make their cascading characteristics gradually approach to the simulated power amplifier nonlinearity. In order to solve the disadvantages in traditional polynomial and look-up table techniques, the proposed method uses multiple lower-odd-order polynomials to piecewise fit nonlinearity for improving simulation precision. And the look-up table is used to store polynomial coefficients for reducing the computational load. The simulation results indicate that the proposed method provides high simulation precision and fast convergence speed.

articleTitle: Design of Distribution Network Intelligent Analysis System Based on Low-Voltage Release and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The paper presents an intelligent analysis system (IAS) to get an accurate analysis of reclosing. The function of IAS is to get the accurate judgment of whether low-voltage release (LVR) reclosed successfully. Firstly, current and voltage variation (CVV) of LVR is recorded by intelligent low-voltage release (ILVR). To make it convenient to measure CVV of LVR for analysis, ILVR measuring function is adopted. And the data is used to analyze operating characteristic (OC) of LVR after restoration in the supply side. Finally, IAS will achieve the judgment. IAS can help LVR users get rid of disadvantages caused by reclosing. With the exact reclosing result, power supply bureau (PSB) can provide accurate information about restoration in DN to customers. And operation personnel can provide manual reclosing according to analysis of IAS. Finally, the validity of IAS was verified by the applications.

articleTitle: Personalized Map Service User Interest Acquisition Based on Browse Behavior
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Browse behavior indicates users' real intention and interest, behavior analysis is an effective way to acquire knowledge of templates and adaptive rules for personalized map service. In this paper, an experiment for single user was introduced, which was carried out in a personalized map service prototype system. Then, an algorithm for user interest mining based on browse behavior was presented, according to which user's browse behavior log in database was analyzed, the interest vector and the corresponding interestingness were obtained, which were important knowledge for personalized navigation and recommendation in web map service.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Multiuser MIMO Non-regenerative Relay System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper, we develop an optimal design for a multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) nonregenerative relay system. This system is equipped with multiple source points, one relay point and multiple destination points. Each node in the system is equipped with multiple antennas. The purpose of this study is to develop fast algorithms to compute the source precoding matrix and the relay amplifying matrix to optimize a system performance. We proposed a two-step algorithm to optimize system performance. First we use zero forcing QR decomposition to construct the source precoding matrix for eliminating the multi-user interference. Second SVD decomposition and water-filling method are used to get the optimal relay amplifying matrix. The simulation results show that the proposed source and relay design algorithms can improve system perform.

articleTitle: A Monitoring System for Underwater Battery Power Based on Coupled Communication Chain
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The Aiming at the underwater equipment whose power supply is battery, a real-time long distance maintenance work is very necessary for the battery. To keep a close watch on the battery, a monitoring system for underwater battery power based on coupled communication chain is presented in this paper. The system selects voltage as the monitoring parameter, gathers and processes the battery power of the working sensor devices, it is linked to CAN bus to join in the sensor network, thus achieving real-time monitoring in land data centre by the transmission of coupled communication. The repeated experiments show that the maximum relative error is less than 0.7%. The system is in favor of remote operation and online monitoring, it greatly expands the quantity and scope of the battery detection technology.

articleTitle: Selecting Good Expansion Terms for Improving XML Retrieval Performance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper, we study how to perform XML query expansion effectively from the high quality pseudo-relevance documents. A solution for selecting good expansion information is presented, in which various features impacting weight, such as term element frequency, term inverse element frequency, semantic weight of tag and level information, are analyzed and those term with high weigh value are selected as expansion term. Experiment results show that proposed expansion method is feasible. Compared to original query and traditional expansion method with no structure features considered, our method achieves better retrieval performance.

articleTitle: Design on Computer Fault Diagnosis of Intelligence Tutoring System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This paper studied the model design of intelligence tutoring system based on the artificial intelligence theory, the designed intelligence tutoring system is used to diagnose computer fault according to computer fault diagnosis expert practical experience, and provide a studying platform on computer fault diagnosis for users themselves.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation on Virtual Network Device of Vehicle Gateway
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Compared to the technology before, the core of the vehicle gateway described in this article are entirely based on the Linux module technology, for example, the Socket virtual network devices mentioned in this article. The low-level kernel technology under Linux ensures the high-tech of the project, the security of the database and the efficiency of the communication.

articleTitle: Research of Remote Measure and Control System for Grain Situation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the design of remote measure and control system for grain situation based on MCU STC12C5A32S2 and GPRS GTM900, has realized the application of text messages, Internet access, real-time measurement and remote control of grain. The hardware and software design of the system has been described in detail. Eventually, these functions above have been completed exactly through the experiment.

articleTitle: A Kind of Multipurpose Digital Measurement Instrument Based on Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This paper introduced a kind of basic measurement principle and method of multipurpose digital measurement instrument based on microcontroller, and some the software design methods was introduced, instrument calibration and reduces error measures. The digital measurement instrument realized A/D convert high precision, and ensured the accuracy of the measurement results. It not only can accurately and fast to measure the AC or DC voltage, current, resistance, but also can measure frequency, pulse signal, it realized digital display. The multipurpose digital measurement instrument has a good anti-interference performance, the measurement operation is simple, convenient, responding time is better rapid. After experiment test, the measurement result is accurate, intuitive.

articleTitle: Network Coding for Linear Finite-Field Deterministic Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: A novel network coding model for linear finite-field deterministic network is considered. In our model, each channel between 2 connected nodes is represented by a channel gain matrix, while each mapping from input signals to output signals in a node is represented by an encoder mapping matrix. We apply our model to algebraic network coding framework introduced by Ralf Koetter and Muriel Médard. Those matrices are regarded as elements to generate the adjacency matrix F, from which the system matrix M can be derived. Based on our model, we propose an algorithm to trace all the feasible routes in a network for given source and destination. We also give the capacity of the network based on the routes enumerated by the algorithm.

articleTitle: Exponential Stability of k Out of N: G Redundant System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper we investigate the dominant eigenvalue and stability of k out of N: G redundant system with repair facilities and multiple critical and non-critical errors. By using the method of functional analysis, especially, the linear operator theory on Banach space, we prove the existence of strictly dominant eigenvalue of the system. We show that the dynamic system is linear stable and exponential stable.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Model and Simulation of Incentive Mechanism for Knowledge Transfer Based on Multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: According to the evolutionary game theory and the basic theory of knowledge transfer, we apply the entire simulation modeling method of Multi-agent complex adaptive system to construct the simulation modeling of knowledge transfer incentive behavior on NetLog simulation platform. The strategic which is taken during the knowledge transfer incentive behavior by analyzing the knowledge transfer incentive behavior of chief enterprise and evolutionary game of members' knowledge transfer under the different return parameters. By analyzing the evolutionary game of virtual enterprise's knowledge transfer incentive mechanism will contribute to the construction of the virtual enterprise's knowledge transfer incentive mechanism.

articleTitle: The Design of Automatic Transmission Line System Based on S7_300PLC
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The automatic transmission line system is design for oil pipeline based on the S7_300PLC and Wincc configuration software in the paper. The system includes hardware design, system function design, software design, network construction and so on. The system collect and control the position to the transportation trolley and the tube in the workshop, so that the steel tube can be transferred automatically, each station can be fed and laid automatically with the manual operation function at the same time. Further, the real-time data can be monitored through the remote supervisory and control system. Since the operation, each function of system is stable and meets to the design requirement.

articleTitle: Parallel Optimization of Frequent Algorithm on Multi-core Processors
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel precision integrated framework (PRIF) to parallelize the famous Frequent algorithm in the context of multi-core processors. PRIF does this by equally distributing the stream of items into several sub-threads, each of which runs an optimized weighted Frequent algorithm independently and in parallel. The items with frequency increments over a pre-defined threshold in the sub-threads are sent to a merging thread which uses the same optimized weighted Frequent algorithm to provide the final e-deficient frequent items. The theoretical correctness analysis is presented. Experiments with three real traffic traces show that PRIF exhibits excellent scalability and delivers almost linear speedup.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Application of IEC61850 in Smart Distribution Grid with Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: New organizational unit of gridthe micro-grid is an integral part of smart distribution network, with the advantages of flexible and efficient use of new energy, IEC61850 communication makes the electrical equipment of different manufacturers interoperate in one system. In this paper digital substation is divided into substation layer, bay layer and process layer based on the IEC61850 communication, this paper analyses the three-layered structure of the digital substation communication systems and the communication of smart distribution grid with micro-gird, explores the information interactive when there are faults in the grid and the feeder terminal unit(FTU)for information modeling, discusses the application of IEC61850 communication in smart distribution grid containing micro-grid.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Providing Elaborate Virtual Block Storage Services in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Persistent block storage (PBS) is widely applied in cloud computing, including Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS), Eucalyptus EBS, OpenStack nova-volume, OpenNebula iSCSI Datastore and Virtual Block Store (VBS) System which provides a more flexible framework compared with them. However they ignore some key issues such as elaborate volume service, data sharing and “hot” volume processing. This paper presents an EVBS model that is built upon VBS. In E-VBS, we provide six types of volume services to serve different types of customer requests and optimize the management of volume authority. We also develop a flexible method to address the issue of “hot” volumes in E-VBS. Our experimental results show that our services work effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: Recognizing the Reliability Non-coherence Components of Bulk Power Systems Based on Reliability Indices Decomposition Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Reliability non-coherence phenomenon may exist in bulk power systems in some cases due to the effects of some factors on the system reliability. Reliability non-coherence component (RNC) has negative impacts on system economy and reliability, so recognizing the RNCs of power systems can effectively improve the system reliability and capital benefit. This paper proposes reliability indices decomposition (RID) method to recognize the RNCs of bulk power systems. Based on RID method, the reliability of systems with any component out of service can be obtained while computing the reliability of the original system. This method is applied in RBTS and IEEE RTS systems, through comparing RID method with direct method, it is verified that RID method can recognize the RNCs of bulk power systems accurately and save much computation time.

articleTitle: Research on PPM of Software Project Schedule Controlling Based on OOPN
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Object-Oriented Petri Nets (OOPN) combines Petri Net theory with object-oriented technology, which effectively solves the passible state explosion problem when modeling the complex systems with basic Petri Nets. The process performance model (PPM) is used to represent past and current software project schedule controllong performance. This article builds the PPM of software project schedule controlling with OOPN. Users can control and adjust the whole project schedule with PPM of software project schedule controlling. Building the software project schedule PPM with OOPN is more convenient and intuitionist than other modeling languages.

articleTitle: Matching Pursuit and Time Reversal Technique for Damage Detection Using Lamb Wave
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Time reversal technique is investigated for health monitoring. The propagation characteristics of Lamb waves in plate-like structure, with emphasis on group velocity and characteristic wave curves are investigated theoretically. The measured signal were decomposed by matching pursuit to enhance the time reversibility of Lamb wave in plate-like structure, the result shows that the defect signals is easy to recognize, then a damage imaging technique is developed by using the time reversal method.

articleTitle: Downlink Reference Signal Design for LTE Compatible GEO Mobile Satellite System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Reference signal (RS) is a crucial signal which is used for channel estimation and data demodulation in 3GPP long term evolution (LTE) system. However, due to the differences of channel environment, interference situation and system physical resource between multiple-beam satellite system and terrestrial system, the original downlink reference signal (DL-RS) design in LTE specifications cannot meet the satellite system demands, leading to performance degradation and waste of resource. In this paper, based on the feature of satellite channel, interference model and physical resource, we calculate the time and frequency domain interval, design the pattern of DL-RS in multiple beam satellite communication system. Furthermore, two DL-RS improvement technology: power boosting, re-transmit and combined receive scheme are mentioned. Simulation results and performance analysis prove the effectiveness of the proposed DL-RS design.

articleTitle: Design of Motion Control System for Intelligent-Transport Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Intelligent-transport vehicle is also known as intelligent-transport robot. Based on Sunplus 16-bit microcontroller, a motion control hardware circuit for intelligent-transport vehicle is given in this paper. The controller can receive the signals from the sensors in the vehicle and response the requests from peripheral events in real time. The hardware circuit provides the vehicle with a powerful platform which can be expanded if needed.

articleTitle: Exponential Stabilization of Time-Delayed Systems with Markovian Jumping
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The exponentially stochastic stabilization problems for stochastic Markov jump systems (MJSs) with uncertain parameters and time-delays are considered. By selecting the appropriate Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional, it gives the sufficient condition such that the MJSs is exponentially stochastically stable and stabilizable. The stability and stabilization criteria are formulated in the form of linear matrix inequalities. Two numerical examples are exploited to illustrate the validity of the developed techniques.

articleTitle: The Design of Selecting Broad Band Signal Frequency Based on the FIR Digital Filters
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication technology, the requirements of the quality of receiver's signal become more and more rigid. But nowadays a variety of wireless communications' coverage generates weak signal area and blind spot. And the cost is too high to set up the analog or digital base station, the infrastructure is also more complicated than we thought. To provide a low cost and simple erection, the equipment with functions of a small base station is necessary. This paper is including a research of CDMA repeater wireless frequency selection system which is based on the FIR digital filter. The article first describes the development of modern mobile communication technology and then illustrates the finite impulse response (FIR) digital filter. It also demonstrates a study of CDMA repeater and proposes a method according to MATLAB window function to design FIR filter in a broadband signal in the repeater frequency selection program. Finally, a satisfactory results is obtained through the computer simulation. The program is simple, reliable, low cost and short design cycle. It proves a preferable prospect for selecting frequency applications in high-speed digital filter design and broadband signals.

articleTitle: AODV Routing Protocol Based on Area Dividing and Node Dormancy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This paper describes the ideal of node dormancy based on area dividing. According to this ideal, the Ad hoc On Demand Distance Vector (AODV) is applied to wireless sensor network. Node's in wireless sensor network has limited of energy and can't be supplied. The existing routing protocol of Ad hoc can't be used on it directly. In view of the existing problem of AODV, we use the ideal of node dormancy based on area dividing. We called this improved AODV protocol IAODV protocol. By adding the ideal of area dividing and node dormancy into AODV, it can restrain much redundancy information produced by flooding broadcast, can largely save the limited energy of nodes, prolong the lifetime of the whole network. This paper discusses the routing algorithm and realization of IAODV protocol, and we also simulate it by using the NS-2.

articleTitle: A Pond Dragging System Motion Simulation Study
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The test pool with a dragging system is one of the basic security conditions for the development of underwater equipment. With the difference of test items, the dragging system technical requirements are also different, through the simulation to simulate the motion strategy of the drag platform and parameter characteristics. According to the technical requirements of a dragging system, we make the movement of the trailer system, calculate the design parameters and design a system-wide movement based on the Qt + OSG technology software simulation.

articleTitle: Physical Layer Design for Free Space Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: A small size Free Space Optical Communication System is introduced, including the hardware and the hardware specified physical layer protocol. In detail, the rapid synchronization method to reduce the handshake bandwidth requirement is demonstrated. The hardware of the system includes the laser driver system, the signal amplifying and shaping system, the data interface system. The hardware specified physical layer protocol is used to interface the outer data, serialize and deserialize the data stream, check transmission errors and schedule the data transmission. The overall system is a FIFO-like system and the user can use it as if he's operating a FIFO. The system is designed mainly for terrestrial FSO link whose signal channel is the atmosphere. Due to the complex composition and activity of the atmosphere, this signal channel brings in great influence on the transmitting laser in it, for example, the absorption and scattering of the atmosphere molecules and aerosols, the scintillation of received laser power caused by the turbulence of the atmosphere, all of which results in a much higher Bit Error Rate (BER) of the communication system than wired communication systems leading to frequent resynchronization. In our system, the sampling clock is generated locally using multi-phase sampling technique rather than PLLbased clock recovery, which helps to rapid synchronization.

articleTitle: CBERS02B-HR Image Data Quality Evaluation and Application Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the CBERS02B-HR image data quality of the Gongliu Forest farm in the West Tianshan Forest area, proceeding from the aspects of geometric orientation and calibration, spatial resolution, and texture, using domestic remote-sensing satellite data to carry out the application research, including extraction of forest thematic information and monitoring of forest resources. Although efforts are still needed for improving the sensor's quality and to strengthen the positioning and processing technology to the CBERS02B-HR image, the results show that spatial resolution, image interpretation and other capabilities have been improved significantly. The CBERS02B-HR image can meet the drawing requirements from 1:50000 scale and higher scale maps, after geometric precision correction. The domestic remote-sensing satellite data can be used effectively in agriculture, forestry, water, land, mapping, disaster monitoring, and other fields.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of an Overlay Network Distributed Transmission Technology in the Municipal Regulatory System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: With the growing popularity of the Internet and the rapid growth of bandwidth, multimedia video transmission has become one of the main trends of the Internet's current and future business development. However, it is more and more difficult for the current Internet network layer and transport layer services to meet the diverse needs of end-to-end transmission performance of the multimedia video services. The paper studies the core network on which national or provincial-level municipal comprehensive monitoring system relies and network congestion in large-scale regulatory data aggregation and distribution. Based on overlay routing and multi-routing load balancing technology, the study breaks through the network routing limitations of IP core network and builds a multi-point dynamic distributed information transmission structure between data servers. Under the premise of not changing the basic routing network switching equipment and protocols of the core IP network, it realizes high-quality end-to-end interactive transmission of multimedia information by upgrading transmission software module at the data server, furthers the multicast transmission service quality of the IP core network and enhances the robustness and QoS of the core network of the regulatory system.

articleTitle: Proactive Recovery in Intrusion-Tolerant System Based on TTCB
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This paper proposes two proactive recovery mechanisms, i.e., periodic grouped proactive recovery and annular proactive recovery. The periodic grouped proactive recovery divides the replicas into groups and each group recover periodically in round. The annular proactive recovery adopts a kind of annular system structure and recovers the replicas dynamically. Although there are some differences between grouped proactive recovery and annular proactive recovery in system size, availability, and security, the results of simulation experiments show that two proactive recovery mechanisms both can improve the availability obviously.

articleTitle: A Research on the Teaching Media Asset Management Mode of Colleges
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This thesis aims to discuss an effective way of integrated teaching media asset management mode by doing a research of the basic background and the meaning of the media asset management in college, analyzing the connotation and the feature of Management system of teaching media assets. In addition, the thesis illustrates the way of developing and utilizing the teaching media management system.

Author Keywords: the teaching media asset integrated management mode
management system of teaching media assets

articleTitle: Study on Automatic Control System of Sealing Machine for Metallic Fuel Tank
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Sealing machines of existing automobile fuel tanks mostly adopt manual control which results in poor universality, low productivity and big machining errors, worst of all, the production quality is difficult to be guaranteed. Therefore, a new type of sealing machine at higher automation level is developed. The application of PLC and touch screen used to control the linkage of three servo motors realizes automatic control of the sealing machine and improves versatility and productivity, In addition, the product quality is guaranteed with the technique of machining at a constant linear velocity.

articleTitle: Moving Process PID Control in Robots' Field
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The main content of this article refers to Analog PID, Positional PID, Incremental PID and Feed forward Compensation PID, introducting their principles and their model analysis, and giving their algorithm simulation results. With its simple structure, good stability, reliable, easy to adjust, PID control is becoming one of the important technical of the process control field, and its study has been the focus of the field of motion control.

articleTitle: A Coreset-Based Semi-supverised Clustering Using One-Class Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The traditional one-class support vector machines problem can be transformed into solving the minimum enclosing ball problem by the use of the corset. In this paper, the notion of the corset is applied to a semi-supervised clustering using one-class support vector machines. Experimental results show that this proposed algorithm not only can maintain the clustering performance, but also can decrease the running time of the clustering method.

articleTitle: An SOA Application Construction Model Based on Timing Constraint
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: The key to establish SOA application is service auto-discovery and composition. Traditional method is static configurable, such as BPEL. But the web services may be not able to satisfy the requirements of time and resource constraint in their later lifecycle. That would produce diffuseness of web service invoking, and furthermore lead to lower availability, configuration efficiency and even application invalidation. In this paper, we present a model for dynamic SOA application construction, and put forward relevant probabilistic algorithm to validate the model's applicability for concurrent and sequential applications respectively.

articleTitle: Networking Based Boundary Contraction of Mobile Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: Mobile sensor networks has been more attention in recent years, which networking algorithm is one of the important issues of their research. Existing mobile networking algorithm is divided into three categories -virtual force method, the Voronoi diagram method and Delaunay triangulation method. This paper analyzes the deficiencies of these three methods, given a new mobile networking algorithm for large-scale mobile sensor networks, really distributed real-time response to network topology changes. Simulations show that the algorithm has good performance.

articleTitle: Performance Uncertainty Impact on WSNs Design Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper we try to characterize wireless sensor network (WSNs) performance uncertainty (PU) attribute, identify the source and cause of PU, then we challenge that performance stability should treated seriously as one metric among other important metrics depending application scenario. We further classify PU impacts on system evaluation and comparison process. Finally, we propose PU mitigation strategy.

articleTitle: An Improved LEACH Cluster Routing Algorithm for the Differential Services
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: An improved PDSL cluster routing algorithm based on LEACH protocol is put forward, by which data owing different priority are provided for differential services and the cluster routing of LEACH protocol is optimized. By making cluster head nodes dynamically select single-hop routing or multi-hop routing, the consumption of network energy is balanced. Simulation result shows that life cycle of PDSL cluster routing algorithm is longer than that of LEACH, and life cycle is increased 11% and network robustness is promoted 1.4% than that of LEACH.

articleTitle: A Double-Ended Interference Assessing System for Short Wave Transmission
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: This paper presents an short wave transmission quality assessing system based on speech signal in which there are some jamming signals to interrupt the normal communication. This work aims to give proper objective assessment of the intensity of interference signal which is consistent with subjective one. Except interference signal, there are also delays at receiver side, which cannot be determined in advance. Firstly, cepstral mean normalization and weighted Mel frequency cepstral coefficient are applied to reduce channel noise. Furthermore, a sliding strategy is proposed to find the best matching point during the objective assessment to deal with the delay problem. In objective and subjective mapping model, two kinds of fitting approaches, named two-pass least square fitting and Akima fitting, are combined for different condition. Experiments show the effectiveness of proposed assessment approach.

articleTitle: A Filled Function Method for Solving Variational Inequality Problems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Control Engineering and Communication Technology
abstract: In this paper a filled function method is suggested for solving finite dimensional variational inequality problems over sets defined by systems of equalities and inequalities. Firstly, based on the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the variational inequality problems, the original problem is converted into a corresponding constrained optimization problem. Subsequently, a new filled function with one parameter is proposed for solving the constrained optimization problem. Some properties of the filled function are studied and discussed. Finally, an algorithm based on the proposed filled function for solving variational inequality problems is presented. The implementation of the algorithm on several test problems is reported with numerical results.
